title: ListQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating List-Formatted Factual Knowledge Retrieval in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19165v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many real-world questions demand not a single fact but an organized collection of them, yet existing factual knowledge benchmarks almost exclusively target single answer retrieval. We introduce ListQA, a benchmark of 9,045 human-curated, cross-validated questions (audited error rate of 1.7%) that require LLMs to recall multiple facts and compose them into structured lists of 3-10 elements. Questions range from flat lists ("Which NCAA teams went undefeated between 2000 and 2024?") to hierarchical lists with sub-attributes ("...and what was their record and result?"), spanning eight categories across 60+ countries. An evergreen design (explicit temporal constraints or historically immutable facts) keeps ground truth valid without periodic updates. For evaluation, we frame element matching as a linear sum assignment problem: optimal bipartite matching paired with LLM-based semantic grading jointly captures factual accuracy, hallucination,

translated_title: ListQA：用于评估大语言模型列表格式事实知识检索的基准
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界中的问题需要的不是单一事实，而是一组有组织的事实集合，然而现有的事实知识基准几乎都只针对单一答案的检索。我们推出了ListQA，这是一个包含9,045个人工策划、交叉验证问题（经审计的错误率为1.7%）的基准，要求大语言模型回忆多个事实并将其组织成包含3-10个元素的结构化列表。问题涵盖从扁平列表（“2000年至2024年间哪些NCAA球队保持不败？”）到带有子属性的层级列表（“……以及他们的战绩和结果如何？”），横跨八大类别和60多个国家。常青设计（明确的时间约束或历史上不可改变的事实）使得标准答案无需定期更新即可保持有效。在评估方面，我们将元素匹配框架化为线性求和分配问题：最优二分图匹配与基于大语言模型的语义评分相结合，共同捕捉事实准确性、幻觉……
tldr: 该论文提出了ListQA基准，包含9,045个人工策划并交叉验证的问题，用于评估大语言模型回忆多个事实并组织成结构化列表的能力，并采用最优二分图匹配与LLM语义评分相结合的评估方法来衡量事实准确性与幻觉。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ListQA, a benchmark of 9,045 human-curated and cross-validated questions for evaluating LLMs' ability to recall multiple facts and compose them into structured lists, using an evaluation method that combines optimal bipartite matching with LLM-based semantic grading.
